  • Constructor Details

    • Cursor3D

      public Cursor3D(String name, Node node)
      Creates a new Cursor3D. If this is a duplicate of an existing cursor in this application an exception is thrown. The cursor is not made live until it is explicitly added to the CursorModule or setCursor is called on a Component3D.

  • Method Details

    • get

      public static Cursor3D get(String name)
      Returns a Cursor3D object registered with the name. This will first look for an application cursor with the supplied name, if one does not exist it will check for a system cursor with the name.
